Chu Yu was good-looking and had a good family background. Despite being male and an irredeemable slacker, he was still elected as Jianing Private School’s school flower by an overwhelming number of votes.

The professor said, “She is my teacher, and I’m her student.”

Science rose, mankind prospered, and the population soared to more than 7 billion. The advancement of science and technology brought us close to each other. We lost our fear, and we believed that we had no natural enemies. We believed that technology is supreme.

President Xu thought he was keeping a caged canary. In reality, he had been played like a fool.
President Xu: ?
Not getting married really isn’t an option now.

110384.synopsis:
When Ronnie opened his eyes again, he discovered he was no longer human, having turned into a giant dragon, and his mind was filled with many new things.
Right after birth, he obtained a life essence comparable to a Creator God… but it seemed completely useless.
Ancient Gods, Devils, Deities, Monsters…
Traversing countless worlds, witnessing innumerable epic stories, seeking out endless truths…
Gazing at the unknown ahead, shrouded in endless darkness, Ronnie looked at his system and couldn’t help but fall silent. Then, he took out a bag of salt from his system space and slammed it fiercely onto the ground.
“What the hell is this?!”
***
Ronnie, an emotionally detached expedition member, meets a bizarre end impaled on an ice pillar in the Arctic. Instead of oblivion, he awakens as a nascent dragon within a mysterious egg, floating in a pocket dimension bordering a terrifying, Chaos-corrupted reality. He learns he is the last remnant of a world that sacrificed everything in a desperate gamble against Chaos, making him a unique “World Dragon” burdened with its legacy and power, but also constantly threatened by Chaos assimilation.
Guided initially by a spectral dragon and later by a quirky, often sarcastic System, Ronnie must navigate his immense, inherited knowledge and burgeoning Chaos Power while desperately trying to strengthen his own mind and will to avoid being consumed. The System grants him the ability to transmigrate across different universes, tasking him with “saving tragedies” in exchange for power-ups and knowledge.
associated_names: 混沌乐子龙的诸天之旅

110896.synopsis:
[A girl who traveled through a book fights a girl who traveled through a book with a system + the evil girl whitewashes herself + gets married first and then falls in love + counterattacks and ab*ses the scum] 
Qin Song opened her eyes and found that she had traveled through a book and became the vicious fake daughter that everyone wanted to beat in the novel.
The fake daughter only had money in her eyes. In order to win favor and money, she did everything to the real daughter – framed, spread rumors, and did whatever vicious things she could.
She finally married a rich man, but she didn’t expect that he would go bankrupt just three months after the marriage!
Qin Song opened her eyes and didn’t enjoy any happiness. She had to open her mouth and suffer as soon as she came.
Looking at the now down-and-out boss, everyone in Yuncheng was sure that Qin Song would abort the child first and then kick the boss away, and turn to the arms of other men.
Unexpectedly, Qin Song not only didn’t kick the boss away, but also hugged the boss’s thigh tightly and gave birth to a fat baby for him!
Qin Song: “I won’t divorce, nor will I look for another man. I only want you. Don’t be discouraged. I will accompany you to make a comeback!”
The boss’ eyes were red: “Okay.”
Later, the richest man in Yuncheng confessed his love to Qin Song in an interview with reporters.
“I want to thank my lover the most. Without her, I wouldn’t be where I am today.”
Qin Song was secretly happy: I bet on the right horse!
[The heroine appears gentle and calm, but she is actually bold and stubborn, a love idiot] 
[The hero appears cold and rational, but he is actually an old fox, full of fishing sense, deliberately seducing]
associated_names: 大佬破产后，被恶毒女配养富了

112432.synopsis:
The protagonist reincarnates as the villainess Catherine Medicis and works hard to change the novel’s ending.
Unlike the original storyline where Catherine faced a tragic death, she survives.
She then meets Eugene Cruiser, her fiancé, whom she had forgotten even in her past life.
Seizing the opportunity to fulfill her lifelong dream, Catherine proposes a restaurant investment to Eugene. He readily agrees, allowing Catherine to finally transform her cherished dream into reality.
Meanwhile, as they work together on this new venture, Eugene gradually develops a genuine interest in Catherine.

114480.synopsis:
“A sound mind dwells in a body of steel!”
After dying a shameful death in his past life—weak, sickly, and utterly unmanly—one man is reborn into a noble family… as a girl?!
Refusing to accept this cruel twist of fate, Irine von Velmund dedicates herself to the Path of Muscle, training relentlessly to forge the ultimate masculine physique! But no matter how many push-ups she crushes or how much iron she pumps, one problem remains: her body is biologically female.
When a fledgling hero arrives with news of the Demon King’s revival, Irine sees her chance—a grand adventure awaits! Clad in adventurer’s gear (and layers of deception), she sets off to become the manliest warrior the world has ever seen.
As the title suggests – expect classic harem chaos, though the real romantic battlefield dynamics won’t kick in until midway. Best enjoyed without overthinking it!
associated_names: 【朗報】修羅場系パーティーに入った俺♀だったが、勇者とフラグの立たない男友達ポジションに落ち着く

114736.synopsis:
【Invincible + Multiple Heroines + Multiverse + Romantic Daily Life + Light Combat + High Martial Arts + Rent Collection Wealth】
At the start, he inherited a rundown house in the urban village from his grandfather. The house had no tenants, but the moment he was diagnosed with a terminal illness, a self-proclaimed empress from the Tianxuan Continent arrived as his first tenant.
Ye Chuan soon discovered that with every new tenant moving in, not only did he receive massive daily payments, but he also obtained unique items related to their backgrounds.
【Acquired Bai Qianshuang’s related item: Tiger Strength Pill—dramatically enhances physical power!】
【Acquired Bai Qianshuang’s related item: Deer Blood Pill—significantly boosts vitality!】
……
From that day on, all sorts of bizarre tenants began appearing in the house: the empress from Tianxuan Continent, an apocalyptic sorceress from the Magic Realm, a mysterious scientific girl who fell through a spacetime rift…
Every single day, he received strange, powerful items and endless money.
Then one day, he suddenly realized—he had become invincible.
Enough, enough! Stop giving me more!
associated_names: 万界收租，女帝也得上供？

114992.synopsis:
The path to immortality is one of solitude, of loneliness, of chilling heights where few can breathe.
Song Changsheng arrived with a volume of Daoist scripture in hand. Faced with the earnest teachings of his elders, the hopes of his clan, and the precarious fate of his family.
Together with countless Song clan disciples, he defies the currents, passing the torch of cultivation from generation to generation, until the Song Immortal Clan stands at the pinnacle of the world!
One day, when he looks back from that peak, all the past will be naught but smoke in the wind.

117808.synopsis:
You Ming transmigrates into the world of Yu‑Gi‑Oh!, specifically the setting of the original Duel Monsters (DM). Excited to use his system cards to dominate and show off to the TV-series duelists, he instead encounters something strange: What does “Underworld” mean? What is “Hell”? What do you mean “I’m already dead”? Huh?
It’s the story of someone who dreams of joining Duel City, but must first win a Resurrection Tournament.
associated_names: 游戏王：您的好友正在杀出冥界

120880.synopsis:
In the psychology department, there’s one thing every student must go through: the Counseling Practicum.
Yeomyeong, a third-year psych major, starts a counseling assignment, only to find that the junior who applied, Dowoon, might not be entirely… normal.
Could it be… sociopath? A personality disorder?
While Yeomyeong struggles with the dilemma of how to handle him, the younger man begins acting cute in the most offbeat, unsettling ways.
He’s annoyingly attractive, and before Yeomyeong knows it, he’s nearly been emotionally devoured.
Every time he tries to push him away, Dowoon backs off quietly, watching him with sly, foxy eyes.
And the problem is… Yeomyeong doesn’t exactly hate it.
But the more sessions they have, the more fragmented memories begin to surface. Familiar images. A familiar face.
Who exactly is this man…?

124208.synopsis:
I was reincarnated into the medieval era, but there’s nothing fun to do here.
Guess I’ll make a game.

127536.synopsis:
Lin Chuge had always been someone many people envied.
She was born into a wealthy family as the only daughter, possessing billions in assets and the endless love of her parents. Even her childhood sweetheart was both the top student and the most handsome boy in school.
However, one day, she realized that she was actually living inside the novel After Rebirth, I Became Everyone’s Favorite. But she was not the reborn, adored female lead—instead, she was the brainless supporting character: s*upid, vicious, and existing only to make the heroine shine.
Although her current life was carefree and comfortable, in the future she would—because of her s*upidity and malice—be trampled beneath the heroine’s feet. Her friends would abandon her, her family’s fortune would be squandered away by her own hands, and in the end she would fall from the clouds into the mud, wandering the streets, dying in misery…
And the root cause of it all was simply because she was… a terrible student!!!
Lin Chuge: %&#@@￥…*%#
This can’t go on.
After being a salted-fish* for over a decade, Lin Chuge exploded with determination:
Knowledge changes destiny! Studying creates the future!
From now on, the only thing in her eyes would be—studying!

129840.synopsis:
Falling into a suddenly appearing sinkhole on her way home from work, she found herself possessed by the world of the horror game she usually loved, .
And not just that, she became the first victim of a psychopathic serial killer!
“You’re quick to catch on, huh? I was going to deal with you immediately if you made too much noise.”
Silas said this with a handsome face and a bright smile. But the meaning behind it was so chilling that it sent shivers down her spine.
How could she survive?
She tried to think with her hair now completely white, but having never reached the ending of the game, she had no idea.
Then…
“H-Honey! Don’t you remember me?”
Determined to survive, she decided to play the part of the serial killer’s wife to the man who had lost his memory.
associated_names: Surviving as the Wife of a Serial Killer

130352.synopsis:
Gabrielle Brooks, unable to escape her tiresome family, barely endures her work life.
One day, a man named Dominic Moore appears before her.
He, her boss at work, seeps into her life like a ray of light.
“About the kiss yesterday, I did it because you were cute.”
“Cute…? What do you mean?”
“Pretending not to be jealous was cute. The way you eat and get it all over your mouth is cute, too.”
Just like that, Gabrielle, after a dream-like romance, is proposed to.
But then, he suddenly disappeared without a trace.
He ran away, stealing her memories.
Without a word, without warning.
“…That bastard. Damn son of a b*tch.”
And after several years, he shamelessly appeared again.
With a new name: Julian Rogers.”
associated_names: The fiancé who had disappeared has returned.

133680.synopsis:
I went back in time, five years before the end of the world.
This time, I swore I would stop the apocalypse and save everyone.
But then…
[Authority Acquired: Hypnosis] 
Why did it have to be this ability?
Once the childhood friend of a hero, I now walk the path of a feared “Hypnosis Villain.”

135472.synopsis:
[Actor Seo Yongwoo, Cat Abandonment Controversy… Where on Earth Did Dodong Go?] 
Seo Yongwoo, a Tiger Shifter active as an actor within the Beastman community, rescues a black cat being ab*sed on set—labeled an ‘unlucky cat’—and begins raising it at home. 
He even names it Dodong and slowly grows attached. However, one day, he wakes from a nap to find Dodong vanished without a trace. Worse, the cat stole Yongwoo’s valuables—even cans of tuna!
The media explodes, claiming Seo Yongwoo abandoned the cat he was raising. To quell the controversy, Seo Yongwoo suggests moving in with Do Haedong, the Cat Shifter who deceived him by pretending to be a mere cat.

163120.synopsis:
【Host detected. Upon joining the top sect of the Immortal Realm, the Hehuan Sect, system reward: Art of Bedchamber Sutra.】
Li Xiuwu stared at the Beijing Film Academy admission letter in his hand.
Reborn in 2002, on the eve of the World Cup, he seized this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and achieved financial freedom in one go. As for what to do in the future—he’d just follow his heart.
associated_names: 北电艺考，系统说是合欢宗

177456.synopsis:
Transmigrating into the cultivation world was exactly what Qiu Yuan had always dreamed of. Why? Because Qiu Yuan is a man driven by pure vanity; to him, failing to look legendary is a fate worse than death.
—
The eldest legitimate son of the Qiu Clan, Qiu Yuan, is renowned throughout the cultivation realm as a once-in-a-century marvel. Legend has it that on the day of his birth, a violent thunderstorm was raging—until the moment he cried out. Instantly, the sky cleared into ten thousand miles of crimson sunset as a hundred phoenixes sang in harmony. A divine omen for a divine talent.
Years later, the masses still speak of him in hushed, reverent tones:
Passerby A: “Indeed! Young Master Qiu, a vision in snow-white robes, once took down forty-eight demons with a single gust-borne strike—and not a single drop of blood dared to stain his sleeves.”
Passerby B: “He is a titan among men. He mastered Qi at birth, established his Foundation at seven, and formed his Golden Core by sixteen. Such genius is simply unheard of!”
The Reality: Qiu Yuan is no miracle child. He’s just… slightly more talented than average.
That “divine omen” at his birth? He spent his months in the womb eavesdropping on his parents’ conversations to track weather patterns, taking mental notes so frantically they nearly sparked, all to calculate the exact second to emerge for maximum dramatic effect.
As for his title as the “eldest legitimate son”? He nearly lost it. His father had a fleet of wives and concubines; four siblings were born that very same day, and three of them began their “descent” before him. To ensure he held the most prestigious title in the family, Qiu Yuan gripped his own umbilical cord and scrambled out like a man possessed, successfully beating the second son by a single minute.
His reputation as a genius is the ultimate facade. He maintains his lead through backbreaking, secret overwork—scouring forbidden realms in the dead of night just to keep his cultivation level high enough to impress.
His swordplay looks “divine” only because he practiced over twenty different theatrical draws.
His hair flutters perfectly in the wind because he’s up at 3:00 AM every morning for a rigorous hair-care routine.
He remains bloodless in battle only because his robes are meticulously coated in a secret, high-grade waterproof wax…
Through sheer image branding, Qiu Yuan successfully cons his way into the world’s top sect and becomes the sole disciple of the greatest sword master alive.
The Great Sword Ancestor, Fu Tianzhao, is a man of extreme functionalism. To him, the shortest distance between two points is a straight line. When he first saw his disciple flourishing his blade dozens of times just to make one simple cut, he initially thought the boy was just profoundly confused.
After a while, the truth finally dawned on him.
His disciple wasn’t confused. He was just pathologically incapable of not showing off.
